meta.mass_source: BrickLink catalogue weights (www.bricklink.com/v2/catalog/catalogitem.page?P=<part>, read 2026-11-04): 3022 0.64 g, 30000 1.81 g, 2458 1.09 g, 3830 1.02 g, 3831 0.83 g, the hose 78c18 1.6 g (shared over its pieces by length) (+/-10 %, P10); Junior's parts from bake_objects.PARTS
meta.colour_source: LDraw LDConfig.ldr colour values (UPDATE 2026-05-29); the hose Flat_Silver 315 by part number
meta.inertia: inertia_gcm2 = [xx, yy, zz, xy, xz, yz] about the centre of mass, per-brick uniform boxes and the hose pieces (their grams by length), g cm^2; a member's its own body
meta.studs: mesh.studs: [x, y, z, sRGB, dir] of each exposed stud's foot, dir +z / +x / -x / +y / -y (sideways on a stood model: EP-c draws them, EP-a drops every dir but +z); drawing only
meta.pieces: parts with a kind: pin-collar / pin-shaft (pin<k>.collar / .shaft, mass 0: the body carries it), hose (hose<chain>.<n>, its grams by length), knuckle (mass 0): plan prisms as the bricks' parts
meta.members: members: [{name, part, parts (collision prisms), mass_g, com_mm, inertia_gcm2, seat: {kind 'pin', host_part, axis (a unit vector, host axes), origin_mm (the collar's face on the axis), length_mm (the engagement), play_mm (the slot's total clearance across the shaft, measured from the slot and the shaft: P8's across bound is play_mm + 1), tolMm} (ES D95), file_position, mesh}]: friction only, never a weld (ES D58)
meta.triangles: mesh.triangles = 12 x boxes + 34 x studs + 44 x each pin collar / shaft and hose piece (a capped 12-gon) + a knuckle's prism (2 n + 2 (n - 2)) + a member's box and studs
